edit.title: Edit tournament
edit.archived: This tournament is archived and can no longer be edited.

locked.seasonStart: Locked for the season: the start cannot change once the season has begun.
locked.seasonEnd: Locked: the season has ended, so the end cannot change.

conflicts.SEASON_LOCKED: The season has already started, so the start can no longer change. Reload the page.
conflicts.SEASON_ENDED: The season has ended, so the end can no longer change. Reload the page.
conflicts.ARCHIVED: This tournament is archived and can no longer be edited.
conflicts.CONFLICT: Someone changed this tournament meanwhile. Reload the page and try again.

errors.NAME_TOO_LONG: The name is too long (80 characters at most).
errors.DESCRIPTION_TOO_LONG: The description is too long (2000 characters at most).
errors.SEASON_START_INVALID: Pick a valid start date and time.
errors.SEASON_END_INVALID: Pick a valid end date and time.
errors.SEASON_END_NOT_AFTER_START: The season end must be after the season start.
errors.ROUTE_UNKNOWN: Choose a route from the list.
errors.ROUTE_DISTANCE_REQUIRED: Enter the route distance in km.
errors.ROUTE_DISTANCE_INVALID: The distance must be a number.
errors.ROUTE_DISTANCE_NOT_POSITIVE: The distance must be greater than 0.
errors.ROUTE_DISTANCE_TOO_PRECISE: The distance can have at most 2 decimals.
errors.ROUTE_DISTANCE_TOO_LARGE: The distance is too large (10,000 km at most).
errors.GENERIC: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.SEASON_END_NOT_AFTER_NOW: The season end must be in the future.
